LineageEdgeAnswer.description: One way an input influences an output of the job.

input_column.description: For a column edge, the input column; for a parameter edge, the parameter name such as @AsOfDate; else null.
input_column.title: Input Column

input_kind.description: column: a column of one of the job's input tables; parameter: a job parameter such as @AsOfDate; constant: a literal in the code; generated: a value the engine makes, such as an IDENTITY key or a load timestamp.
input_kind.title: Input Kind

input_table.description: For a column edge, the job INPUT table it belongs to, schema-qualified (trace through temp tables and work data sets back to the job's inputs); else null.
input_table.title: Input Table

kind.description: derives: the input's value flows into the output column; filters: it decides which rows appear (WHERE, JOIN ON, HAVING, IN=, subsetting IF); ranks: it decides which row survives (ORDER BY in a ROW_NUMBER, NODUPKEY, FIRST./LAST.).
kind.title: Kind

lines.description: Line numbers in the legacy file that show the edge.
lines.title: Lines

output_column.description: The output column the edge feeds; null for an edge that decides which rows appear (a filter) or which row survives (a ranking).
output_column.title: Output Column

output_table.description: The job's output table, schema-qualified, e.g. rpt.claims_summary.

transform.description: A few words on the logic, e.g. 'UPPER(RTRIM(lob_code))'.

request.prompt:
Job T02: usp_load_dim_policy (tsql), file estate/tsql/T02_usp_load_dim_policy.sql.
Policy dimension with type-2 history, loaded once per policy snapshot.
Parameters: SnapshotDate.

Code:
  1 | /*==============================================================================
  2 |   Job      : dw.usp_load_dim_policy
  3 |   Purpose  : Policy dimension for finance, actuarial and broker reporting. One
  4 |              row per version of a policy term, with its product, broker and
  5 |              customer segment. A new version starts whenever the status,
  6 |              broker, annual premium or vehicle registration changes from one
  7 |              policy snapshot to the next (type 2 history).
  8 |   Run by   : POL_SNAPSHOT_LOAD, once per policy snapshot, oldest first:
  9 |              EXEC dw.usp_load_dim_policy @SnapshotDate = '<snapshot date>'
 10 |   Output   : dw.dim_policy. Keeps history, so the procedure never truncates
 11 |              it. Deploying this script recreates the table empty: reload every
 12 |              snapshot in date order afterwards.
 13 |   Author   : MOB
 14 | 
 15 |   Change log
 16 |     2014-02-10  MOB   Initial version, one row per policy (CR-0655)
 17 |     2015-06-22  MOB   Broker name from the broker register (CR-0790)
 18 |     2016-09-05  TF    Direct business reported as broker DIRECT-SALES (CR-0961)
 19 |     2017-03-13  TF    Type 2 history with MERGE, surrogate key policy_sk
 20 |                       (CR-1077)
 21 |     2018-10-01  PH    Vehicle registration tracked for motor (CR-1388)
 22 |     2019-07-15  PH    Customer segment from dw.dim_customer (CR-1610)
 23 |     2020-02-03  TF    Refuse a snapshot older than the last one loaded
 24 |                       (INC-2105)
 25 |     2021-06-14  KB    Logging through etl.usp_log_step (CR-2003)
 26 | ==============================================================================*/
 27 | SET NOCOUNT ON;
 28 | GO
 29 | IF OBJECT_ID(N'dw.dim_policy', N'U') IS NOT NULL
 30 |     DROP TABLE dw.dim_policy;
 31 | 
 32 | CREATE TABLE dw.dim_policy (
 33 |     policy_sk             INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
 34 |     policy_id             INT            NOT NULL,
 35 |     policy_number         VARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL,
 36 |     customer_id           INT            NOT NULL,
 37 |     customer_segment      CHAR(4)        NULL,
 38 |     product_code          VARCHAR(10)    NOT NULL,
 39 |     product_name          NVARCHAR(60)   NOT NULL,
 40 |     lob_code              VARCHAR(5)     NOT NULL,
 41 |     broker_code           VARCHAR(12)    NOT NULL,
 42 |     broker_name           NVARCHAR(80)   NULL,
 43 |     status                VARCHAR(12)    NOT NULL,
 44 |     inception_date        DATE           NOT NULL,
 45 |     expiry_date           DATE           NOT NULL,
 46 |     cancellation_date     DATE           NULL,
 47 |     annual_premium        DECIMAL(12,2)  NOT NULL,
 48 |     currency              CHAR(3)        NOT NULL,
 49 |     vehicle_reg           VARCHAR(12)    NULL,
 50 |     ncd_years             INT            NULL,
 51 |     valid_from            DATE           NOT NULL,
 52 |     valid_to              DATE           NOT NULL,   -- 9999-12-31 while current
 53 |     is_current            CHAR(1)        NOT NULL,   -- Y / N
 54 |     source_snapshot_date  DATE           NOT NULL,
 55 |     load_ts               DATETIME2(3)   NOT NULL,
 56 |     CONSTRAINT pk_dim_policy PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (policy_sk)
 57 | );
 58 | 
 59 | CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX ix_dim_policy_policy_id ON dw.dim_policy (policy_id, is_current);
 60 | GO
 61 | CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dw.usp_load_dim_policy
 62 |     @SnapshotDate DATE
 63 | AS
 64 | BEGIN
 65 |     SET NOCOUNT ON;
 66 | 
 67 |     DECLARE @job_name     VARCHAR(128) = 'dw.usp_load_dim_policy',
 68 |             @rows         INT,
 69 |             @closed       INT,
 70 |             @last_loaded  DATE,
 71 |             @err_msg      NVARCHAR(4000),
 72 |             @err_no       INT;
 73 | 
 74 |     BEGIN TRY
 75 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'start', @status = 'STARTED';
 76 | 
 77 |         /* Oldest snapshot first: loading an older snapshot after a newer one
 78 |            would reopen versions that are already closed (INC-2105) */
 79 |         SELECT  @last_loaded = MAX(d.source_snapshot_date)
 80 |         FROM    dw.dim_policy d;
 81 | 
 82 |         IF @SnapshotDate < @last_loaded
 83 |             THROW 50001, 'dw.dim_policy already holds a later policy snapshot', 1;
 84 | 
 85 |         IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#src') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #src;
 86 | 
 87 |         /* 1. This snapshot's policies with product, broker and customer segment */
 88 |         SELECT  p.policy_id,
 89 |                 p.policy_number,
 90 |                 p.customer_id,
 91 |                 c.segment_code                          AS customer_segment,
 92 |                 pr.product_code,
 93 |                 pr.product_name,
 94 |                 pr.lob_code,
 95 |                 ISNULL(p.broker_code, 'DIRECT-SALES')   AS broker_code,
 96 |                 b.broker_name,
 97 |                 p.status,
 98 |                 p.inception_date,
 99 |                 p.expiry_date,
100 |                 p.cancellation_date,
101 |                 p.annual_premium,
102 |                 p.currency,
103 |                 p.vehicle_reg,
104 |                 p.ncd_years
105 |         INTO    #src
106 |         FROM    stg.policy_snapshots p WITH (NOLOCK)
107 |         JOIN    stg.products pr WITH (NOLOCK)
108 |                 ON pr.product_code = p.product_code
109 |         LEFT JOIN stg.brokers b WITH (NOLOCK)
110 |                ON b.broker_code = p.broker_code
111 |         LEFT JOIN dw.dim_customer c WITH (NOLOCK)
112 |                ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
113 |         WHERE   p.snapshot_date = @SnapshotDate;
114 | 
115 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
116 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'policy snapshot', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
117 | 
118 |         IF @rows = 0
119 |             THROW 50002, 'No policies found for this snapshot date', 1;
120 | 
121 |         CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX ix_src_policy_id ON #src (policy_id);
122 | 
123 |         BEGIN TRANSACTION;
124 | 
125 |         /* 2. Close the current version of policies whose status, broker, premium
126 |               or vehicle registration has changed since the last snapshot */
127 |         MERGE dw.dim_policy AS tgt
128 |         USING #src AS src
129 |            ON tgt.policy_id = src.policy_id
130 |           AND tgt.is_current = 'Y'
131 |         WHEN MATCHED AND (   ISNULL(src.status, '')        <> ISNULL(tgt.status, '')
132 |                           OR ISNULL(src.broker_code, '')   <> ISNULL(tgt.broker_code, '')
133 |                           OR ISNULL(src.annual_premium, 0) <> ISNULL(tgt.annual_premium, 0)
134 |                           OR ISNULL(src.vehicle_reg, '')   <> ISNULL(tgt.vehicle_reg, ''))
135 |         THEN UPDATE
136 |              SET    tgt.valid_to   = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @SnapshotDate),
137 |                     tgt.is_current = 'N';
138 | 
139 |         SET @closed = @@ROWCOUNT;
140 | 
141 |         /* 3. Open a current version for new policies and for those closed above */
142 |         INSERT INTO dw.dim_policy
143 |                (policy_id, policy_number, customer_id, customer_segment, product_code,
144 |                 product_name, lob_code, broker_code, broker_name, status, inception_date,
145 |                 expiry_date, cancellation_date, annual_premium, currency, vehicle_reg,
146 |                 ncd_years, valid_from, valid_to, is_current, source_snapshot_date, load_ts)
147 |         SELECT  s.policy_id, s.policy_number, s.customer_id, s.customer_segment, s.product_code,
148 |                 s.product_name, s.lob_code, s.broker_code, s.broker_name, s.status,
149 |                 s.inception_date, s.expiry_date, s.cancellation_date, s.annual_premium,
150 |                 s.currency, s.vehicle_reg, s.ncd_years,
151 |                 @SnapshotDate,
152 |                 '9999-12-31',
153 |                 'Y',
154 |                 @SnapshotDate,
155 |                 SYSDATETIME()
156 |         FROM    #src s
157 |         WHERE   NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
158 |                             FROM   dw.dim_policy d
159 |                             WHERE  d.policy_id = s.policy_id
160 |                               AND  d.is_current = 'Y')
161 |         ORDER BY s.policy_id;
162 | 
163 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
164 | 
165 |         COMMIT TRANSACTION;
166 | 
167 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'versions closed', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @closed;
168 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'versions opened', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
169 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'SUCCESS';
170 |     END TRY
171 |     BEGIN CATCH
172 |         IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
173 | 
174 |         SELECT  @err_msg = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
175 |                 @err_no  = ERROR_NUMBER();
176 | 
177 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job_name, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'FAILED',
178 |              @message = @err_msg, @error_number = @err_no;
179 |         THROW;
180 |     END CATCH
181 | END;
182 | GO

Input tables:
- stg.policy_snapshots: snapshot_date DATE, policy_id INT, policy_number VARCHAR(20), customer_id INT, product_code VARCHAR(10), broker_code VARCHAR(10), inception_date DATE, expiry_date DATE, status VARCHAR(12), cancellation_date DATE, annual_premium DECIMAL(12,2), currency CHAR(3), sum_insured DECIMAL(14,2), payment_frequency VARCHAR(10), vehicle_reg VARCHAR(12), ncd_years INT, _row_seq INT
- stg.brokers: broker_code CHAR(6), broker_name NVARCHAR(80), region VARCHAR(20), commission_rate DECIMAL(5,4), status VARCHAR(10), appointed_date DATE, _row_seq INT
- stg.products: product_code VARCHAR(10), product_name NVARCHAR(60), lob_code VARCHAR(5), term_months INT, levy_rate DECIMAL(5,4), launched_on DATE, withdrawn_on DATE, _row_seq INT
- dw.dim_customer: customer_id INT, first_name NVARCHAR(40), last_name NVARCHAR(60), full_name NVARCHAR(101), initials NVARCHAR(2), email VARCHAR(120), email_shared_count INT, date_of_birth DATE, age_at_join INT, address_line1 NVARCHAR(100), town NVARCHAR(50), county VARCHAR(30), region VARCHAR(12), eircode VARCHAR(10), eircode_valid CHAR(1), segment_code CHAR(4), is_standard_segment CHAR(1), marketing_opt_in CHAR(1), customer_since DATE, source_system VARCHAR(10), version_count INT, record_updated_at DATETIME2(0), as_of_date DATE
- dw.dim_policy: policy_sk INT, policy_id INT, policy_number VARCHAR(20), customer_id INT, customer_segment CHAR(4), product_code VARCHAR(10), product_name NVARCHAR(60), lob_code VARCHAR(5), broker_code VARCHAR(12), broker_name NVARCHAR(80), status VARCHAR(12), inception_date DATE, expiry_date DATE, cancellation_date DATE, annual_premium DECIMAL(12,2), currency CHAR(3), vehicle_reg VARCHAR(12), ncd_years INT, valid_from DATE, valid_to DATE, is_current CHAR(1), source_snapshot_date DATE, load_ts DATETIME2(3)

Output tables:
- dw.dim_policy: policy_sk INT, policy_id INT, policy_number VARCHAR(20), customer_id INT, customer_segment CHAR(4), product_code VARCHAR(10), product_name NVARCHAR(60), lob_code VARCHAR(5), broker_code VARCHAR(12), broker_name NVARCHAR(80), status VARCHAR(12), inception_date DATE, expiry_date DATE, cancellation_date DATE, annual_premium DECIMAL(12,2), currency CHAR(3), vehicle_reg VARCHAR(12), ncd_years INT, valid_from DATE, valid_to DATE, is_current CHAR(1), source_snapshot_date DATE, load_ts DATETIME2(3)

edges.transform: c.segment_code via LEFT JOIN on customer_id
pr.product_code (equal to p.product_code by inner join)
b.broker_name via LEFT JOIN on broker_code
DATEADD(DAY,-1,@SnapshotDate) when closing a version (MERGE UPDATE)
p.snapshot_date = @SnapshotDate; also refuse if older than last loaded snapshot
LEFT JOIN b.broker_code = p.broker_code (row fan-out only); also MERGE change test
MERGE ON tgt.policy_id = src.policy_id; NOT EXISTS d.policy_id = s.policy_id
MERGE ON tgt.policy_id = src.policy_id; NOT EXISTS d.policy_id = s.policy_id
tgt.is_current = 'Y' in MERGE; d.is_current = 'Y' in NOT EXISTS

structured_output.notes:
dw.dim_policy is both an input and the output: the job never truncates it. The MERGE closes changed current versions by setting valid_to = @SnapshotDate - 1 and is_current = 'N'. The INSERT then opens a new version for policies that have no current row left. The change test compares the snapshot with the current row on status, broker_code (after ISNULL to 'DIRECT-SALES'), annual_premium and vehicle_reg. It is listed as filters from both sides because it decides which rows get closed and re-versioned.

product_code comes from pr.product_code, which always equals p.product_code because of the inner join. The LEFT JOIN keys to stg.brokers and dw.dim_customer don't remove rows, but they could duplicate them, so I gave them lower confidence as filters.

stg.brokers.broker_code is CHAR(6) while p.broker_code is VARCHAR(10). The join therefore matches only codes of 6 characters or fewer, because SQL Server ignores trailing spaces when comparing. Spark comparisons don't ignore trailing spaces, so the migrated join should trim or pad the codes.

The @last_loaded guard stops the whole run (THROW) instead of filtering rows. It's listed as a low-confidence filter on source_snapshot_date.

The script drops and recreates dw.dim_policy on deploy (lines 29-57). That is DDL, not part of the procedure's run.

ORDER BY s.policy_id on the INSERT changes only the order in which IDENTITY values are assigned to policy_sk. It doesn't decide which rows appear. To match policy_sk values, the migration must reproduce that order.
